## c4f3344e6cee

**Reproduced defect — domain validation is far broader than the declared marker grammar.** The audited source hash is `bfa1b8305dca11bbd4e111f4f1fe60a1eb789740f5017d169af36dee5b02b678`. Direct calls show `self_check` accepts all of the following with no errors: a 1×1 singleton, a 1×3 line, a solid 2×2 block, and a 9×9 grid containing two cells of the same color. These violate the advertised 9..18 canvas and distinct sparse single-marker assumptions. Exact grids and return values are retained in `checks/audit/c4f3344e6cee/domain-impostors.json`.

The independent strict audit also found no task-local/frozen tests and no semantic contract, so it cannot establish that lessons teach the selected rule; see `checks/audit/c4f3344e6cee/checks/c4f3344e6cee_audit_semantic_gate.log`. Defect lint independently reproduced singleton/short-line/solid-2×2 acceptance, missing `RULE_HASH`, permissive scalar handling, and negative textures mixed into the ordinary domain in `checks/audit/c4f3344e6cee-defect-lint/checks/c4f3344e6cee_audit_defect_lint.log`.

**Impact.** Generator-domain validation can certify off-grammar inputs, weakening override checks and future counterexample evidence even when the Racket label itself executes. No source fix was made; this is a findings-only audit.
